PREAMBULE
We, Member States of the African Union
(AU):
GUIDED by the objectives and principles
enshrined in the Constitutive Act of the
African Union, particularly Articles 3 and
4, which emphasise the significance of
good governance, popular participation,
the rule of law and human rights;
INSPIRED by the Yaounde Declaration
adopted by African Ministers in charge of
Decentralisation and Local Development
on the 29th October 2005;
RECALLING the AU Executive Council
Decision EX.CL./Dec.677 (XX) adopted
in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia on 28th January
2012 as endorsed by the Assembly of
Heads of State and Government relating to
the development of an African Charter on
the Values, Principles and Standards of
Decentralisation and Local Governance;
3
INSPIRED by the vision of the African
Union of an integrated, prosperous and
peaceful Africa, driven by its own citizens
and representing a dynamic force in the
global arena;
RECALLING the African Charter on
Human and Peoples Rights (1981), the AU
Convention on Preventing and Combating
Corruption (2003), the African Charter on
Democracy, Elections and Governance
(2007), the African Charter on the Values
and the Principles of Public Service and
Administration (2011);
RECOGNISING the contribution of
regional organisations, Member States,
local authorities associations, civil society
organisations and traditional leaders in
promoting, protecting, strengthening and
consolidating decentralisation, local
governance and local development;
4
DETERMINED to promote the values
and principles of decentralisation, local
governance and local development in
Africa as a means for improving the
livelihood of all peoples on the continent;
CONVINCED that local governments or
local authorities are key cornerstones of
any democratic governance system;
REAFFIRMING our collective will to
deepen participatory democracy, citizens
and community empowerment; to promote
accountability and transparency of public
institutions, promote and protect cultural
diversity, and promote gender and transgenerational equity at the local or subnational level;
5
COMMITTED to ensure access to basic
services for all people on the continent;
RECOGNIZING the various forms of
decentralisation, including devolution,
deconcentration and delegation in the
political, administrative and financial
spheres;
Have agreed as follows:
CHAPTER I: DEFINITIONS,
OBJECTIVES, SCOPE AND VALUES

articles.heading: Local Governance 13 1. State parties shall enact domestic laws/regulations, recognising different
articles.text:
levels of government with the mandate to
exercise their competencies through
clearly defined regulatory mechanisms.
2. Local governments or local authorities
shall in accordance with national law, have
the powers, to in an accountable and
transparent manner, manage their
administration and finances through
democratically elected, deliberative
assemblies and executive organs.
3. Geographical boundaries of areas falling
within the jurisdiction of local
governments or local authorities shall be
modified in accordance with the provisions
of the law.
4. Local governments or local authorities
shall be consulted through clearly defined
regulations on national or sub-national
legal instruments, sectoral policies,
programmes, or projects that directly or
14
indirectly affect their competencies to
impact on the lives of local populations.

articles.heading: Subsidiarity 1. Central government shall create enabling conditions for decision-making, policy and programme initiation, adoption
articles.text:
and implementation to take place at lower
levels of government where local
governments or local authorities offer a
better guarantee of pertinence and efficacy.
2. Central governments shall create
enabling conditions for cooperation and
coordination between national and all subnational levels of government and shall
empower local governments or local
authorities to discharge their duties and
responsibilities.
3. Local governments or local authorities
shall cooperate with central governments
and other local actors to achieve increased
15
efficiency and effectiveness in public
action for the delivery of public services.

articles.heading: Resource Mobilisation and Local Economic Development 1. Central governments shall adopt legislation, measures and establish relevant
articles.text:
mechanisms to give local governments the
authority to mobilise and disburse
resources at the local level for local
economic development.
2. Central governments shall adopt
legislation and create the necessary
oversight and evaluation mechanisms to
ensure that the percentage of revenue
raised at the national and local levels are
effectively transferred to local
governments or local authorities for local
economic development.
3. Central governments shall work in close
collaboration with local governments or
local authorities to promote private sector
16
and community development investments
or initiatives through legislative, financial
and institutional frameworks.
4. Local governments or local authorities
shall, in accordance with the law, and in an
accountable and transparent manner, raise,
manage and administer local resources in
consultation with central government, civil
society and the private sector through
legislative, institutional and clearly defined
and regulated participatory mechanisms.
5. Local governments or local authorities
shall encourage and ensure that civil
society, private sector, communities,
national and sub-national entities pay local
taxes and user fees through clearly
established, transparent and efficient
mechanisms.
17

articles.heading: Diversity and Differentiation Without prejudice to observance of this Charter
articles.text:
1. Local governments or local authorities
shall exercise their powers having regard to
local realities, values, and customs as well
as national principles, norms and
standards.
2. In accordance with the law local
programmes, projects or initiatives shall be
implemented in consultation with
stakeholders and carried out in such a
manner as to recognise the cultural,
religious and gender diversity of the people
within its territory in urban and rural areas.
3. Central and Local Governments or Local
Authorities may establish consultative
mechanisms, informed by local conditions
to make proposals or give opinions
concerning guidelines or decisions on local
development.
18
However, the role of local elected
authorities shall remain primary.

articles.heading: By-Laws 1. Local governments shall adopt by-laws, develop and implement local programmes, projects or initiatives in a manner
articles.text:
consistent with national laws and
regulations.
2. States which are party to regional,
continental and/or global treaties and
policy instruments shall support and ensure
local governments to comply with such
instruments and treaties at the local level.

articles.heading: Inclusion, Equity and Equality 1. Local governments or local authorities shall discharge their responsibilities and
articles.text:
19
duties in a manner that it is inclusive,
equitable and gives equal treatment to all
local residents to ensure that citizens and
local residents have equitable access to
quality services.
2. Local governments or local authorities
shall ensure that historically marginalised
groups and poor communities in both rural
and urban areas shall be included and given
priority in service delivery.
3. Local governments or local authorities
shall develop pro-poor initiatives and pay
particular attention to women and the
youth, as well as vulnerable groups
including but not limited to the elderly,
persons with disability, HIV/AIDSaffected households, child-headed
households, street children, the indigent,
the illiterate, slum dwellers, poor rural
households, the unemployed and
underemployed, refugees, the homeless,
the displaced minorities in programme or
20
project development, implementation and
service delivery.
4. Local governments or local authorities
shall not discriminate on the basis of sex,
age, disability, social status, religion, place
of origin, ethnic or racial origin, linguistic
association and political ideology in
exercising their functions, setting policies,
planning, implementing, monitoring and
evaluating programmes or projects.
5. Local governments or local authorities
shall discharge their duties and
responsibilities having regard to
sustainable development, which includes
the development of future generations,
inter-generational development and
environmental sustainability into account.

articles.heading: Shared responsibility and complementarity State Parties shall ensure that
articles.text:
21
a) Local governments or local authorities
promote and improve the livelihoods and
environment of local communities.
b) Local governments or local authorities,
in the spirit of good local and central
government relations, involve all relevant
national, sub-national, private sector and
civil society actors in the development and
implementation of local development plans
and programmes, and ensure consistency
with national, regional or continental
development policies.
c) Local governments or local authorities
specify their local development plans and
programmes in operational cooperation
frameworks, such as a Commitments
Charter, which shall be adopted by all
relevant actors.
22
d) Central and local governments or local
authorities are bound by law to establish
mechanisms to cooperate and support each
other to attain global, continental, regional,
national, and local development priorities.
e) They establish mechanisms of
cooperation between national development
agencies, public institutions, private sector
and civil society on the one hand with local
governments or local authorities on the
other hand, to support the implementation
of local development priorities.
f) Local governments or local authorities
are accountable to local communities
regarding local development decisions and
policies, the implementation of such
decisions and policies and the management
of financial resources. Local community
and citizen responsibilities in this respect
shall be clearly defined to facilitate
collaboration with local governments or
local authorities.
23
g) Local governments or local authorities,
in accordance with national legislation and
in the spirit of good cooperative
governance, are accountable to central
governments and communities as regards
the discharging of their duties and
responsibilities and in the implementation
of programmes, projects or policies.

articles.heading: Participation 1. National legislation shall guarantee the rights and outline responsibilities of
articles.text:
citizens to participate in public life at the
local level.
2. Democracy shall be the foundation of
local governance and shall take a
participatory and representative form.
3. Local governments or local authorities
shall promote participation of all segments
of society in the planning, implementation,
24
monitoring and evaluation of policies,
programmes and projects through
structured community platforms and other
forms of participation to ensure the
delivery of quality services.
4. Local governments or local authorities
shall promote the development of
innovative democratic and peaceful public
expression platforms.
5. Local governments or local authorities
shall make provision for the meaningful
participation of communities, civil society
and other actors in local governance and
development.
6. Central governments, in collaboration
with local governments or local authorities,
shall invite and encourage the full
participation of the African diaspora in the
promotion of decentralization, local
governance and local development through
clearly defined policies and mechanisms.
25
7. National legislation shall be enacted to
empower and encourage local
governments or local authorities to adopt
appropriate forms of popular participation,
civic engagement and other forms of
expression.

articles.heading: Representation 1. Election of local public officials shall be enshrined within the legal framework of
articles.text:
State Parties, which shall clearly define the
modalities and timeframes for such
elections.
2. Central governments shall enact
electoral laws that promote regular,
democratic, free, fair and transparent local
government elections.
3. Central governments shall establish
innovative measures and appropriate
mechanisms to ensure the full participation
of all eligible citizens, including specific
26
measures for the representation of women
and marginalised groups in local
government elections within the
framework of national legislation.
4. Local public officials shall duly
represent the interests of local communities
and shall consult with their populations on
an on-going and regular basis through
clearly specified mechanisms and
timeframes.
5. Central governments shall adopt
legislation and establish administrative and
financial mechanisms and use Information
and Communication Technology (ICT) to
encourage local residents and communities
to provide feedback to their locally elected
representatives, make their grievances
heard, and seek redress.

articles.heading: Transparency, Accountability and Ethical Behaviour 27 1. Measures for the promotion of
articles.text:
transparency and accountability by local
governments or local authorities shall be
clearly outlined in national legislation.
Such legislation shall clearly define the
respective roles and responsibilities of
national and sub-national governments,
public agencies, service providers, elected
and administrative officials, and civil
society organizations.
2. Central governments and local
governments or local authorities shall
make provisions for community
participation and establish accountability
systems in local governance and local
development programmes by publishing
annual local government performance
reports and disclosing financial statements
in full.
3. Central governments and local
governments or local authorities shall
establish mechanisms to combat all forms
of corruption.
28
4. Central governments and local
governments or local authorities shall
establish innovative mechanisms in the
resolution of grievances to promote and
protect whistle-blowing relating to all
forms of corrupt behaviour and practice,
including bribery, patronage and nepotism,
as well as the resolution of grievances.
5. Local public officials shall display
ethical behaviour and integrity in
discharging their duties.
6. Central governments shall adopt
legislation and create mechanisms to
monitor standards of ethical behaviour by
local governments or local authorities.

articles.heading: Mainstreaming Gender, Youth and Disability 29 1. Local governments or local authorities
articles.text:
shall integrate gender, youth and disability
issues in the overall process of formulating
policy, planning for development and
providing services, as well as in
implementing, monitoring and evaluating
development programmes and projects.
2. Local governments or local authorities
shall promote and ensure the equal and
effective participation of women, youth
and people with disability in public life,
leadership and management positions on
all matters relating to local governance and
local development.
3. Local governments or local authorities
shall promote and increase participation of
women, youth and people with disability in
all matters relating to local governance and
local development.
30

articles.heading: Efficiency 1. Local Governance Administration a) National legislation shall be adopted to empower local governments to determine
articles.text:
and manage the organization of local
public administration within a common
national framework of standards, in order
to ensure effective and enhanced delivery
of quality and affordable services to local
communities.
b) Local governments or local authorities
shall Identify and Implement innovative
service delivery modalities to local
populations within a framework of national
legislation.
2. Resource mobilisation and utilisation
a) Local governments shall be provided
with the required human, financial and
technological resources to effectively and
efficiently discharge their responsibilities.
31
b) Information and Communication
Technology (ICT) shall be made accessible
and effectively used to make local
governance and local development more
effective and efficient.
3. Capacity development
a) Local governments or local authorities,
as well as local government associations,
shall undertake comprehensive and
continuous capacity development
initiatives to enhance the performance of
locally elected representatives and officials
to effectively and efficiently carry out their
duties and functions.
b) Central governments shall establish civil
service institutions, create special
programmes and develop special curricula
on local government and local public
administration.
32
c) Central governments shall encourage
such initiatives to share experiences and
best practices at the bilateral, regional and
continental level.
d) Communities, civil society and citizens
shall benefit from capacity development in
order to effectively contribute to local
public administration and local
development.
e) State Parties shall promote voluntary
peer review processes within and between
countries.
4. Natural Resources
a) State Parties shall adopt national
legislation and establish mechanisms
which include local government, civil
society and local populations to ensure
adequate protection and sustainable use of
natural resources at the local level.
b) State Parties shall adopt national
legislation and create mechanisms which
33
include local government, civil society, and
local populations for local communities to
benefit from natural resources exploited in
their communities.
c) Central governments shall be
responsible to equitably redistribute
natural resource benefits acquired from
natural resource exploitation in given
localities and communities to all subnational governments and local
communities.
5. Local Governance Financing, Financial
Management and Local Development
a) Central governments shall enact national
legislation which strives to entrust local
governments with the full responsibility to
manage financial resources at the local
level.
b) Central government shall ensure,
through appropriate support and oversight,
that allocated financial resources are
managed effectively and efficiently
34
without undermining the principle of local
financial autonomy.
c) National legislation shall be adopted to
ensure the financial sustainability of local
governments.
d) Central governments shall define local
resources as well as conditional and
unconditional financial transfers.
e) Conditional and unconditional financial
transfers from central government to local
governments or local authorities shall be
transparent and predictable.
f) Conditions under which local
governments shall gain access to loans,
financial markets, and development
assistance shall be defined by law.
g) Local governments shall implement
accounting, auditing and management
35
systems for the effective, efficient and
transparent management of financial
resources in strict compliance with national
financial and accounting laws, norms and
standards.
h) Local governments or local authorities
shall identify and establish mechanisms
and processes for the efficient or optimal
use of financial resources in the delivery of
quality services as defined by law.

articles.heading: Solidarity, Cooperation and Partnership 1. National laws shall be adopted to regulate conditions under which local
articles.text:
governments or local authorities may form
partnerships or cooperate with local
governments of other African countries to
achieve common local, national and
regional development and continental
integration objectives.
2. Local governments or local authorities
may enter into appropriate partnerships
36
with non-African local governments to
promote cooperation, especially SouthSouth cooperation.
3. National legislation shall be adopted to
recognize the right of local governments or
local authorities to form a national
association to cooperate and collaborate.
4. Such national association shall be
governed by public law and shall be
integrated into the decentralisation
management institutional mechanism.
5. Local governments or local government
associations at the national level shall be
free to join regional, continental and global
local government associations.
6. Central governments shall encourage,
support and ensure the full participation of
local government associations as the
collective voice of local governments in
37
national, regional and continental
development matters or decisions.
7. Central governments shall encourage
and support the independent and effective
functioning of local government
associations.
8. Regional integration initiatives shall
promote local government or local
authority cooperation among Member
States; the framework for cross- border
cooperation shall be established by
Member States and Regional Economic
Communities.
9. Central governments shall support local
governments to fully participate in
processes, mechanisms and programmes at
the regional and continental levels.
38
CHAPTER III: MECHANISMS FOR
IMPLEMENTATION

articles.heading: Follow-up mechanisms To give effect to the commitments contained in this Charter, the actions listed
articles.text:
below shall be taken at the following
levels:
1. Implementation at Individual State Party
Level
a) Local government or local authority
level
Local governments or local authorities
shall:
i) Equally be responsible and accountable
to their local populations for the
implementation of the objectives of this
Charter, and the adherence to its values and
principles;
39
ii) Cooperate with central government and
other sub-national levels of governments to
realise shared development priorities;
iii) Participate in national Local
Government Associations and collaborate
with civil society and the private sector to
achieve the objetives of the Charter;
iv) Demonstrate the political will to
advocate for and ensure the
implementation of the objectives, values
and principles of this Charter, together with
the central government;
v) Commit to create favourable conditions
for the dissemination and implementation
of this Charter; and
vi) Commit to participate in the
monitoring, evaluation and reporting of the
implementation of this Charter.
b) Central government level
40
To ensure and facilitate the implementation
of this Charter, State Parties shall:
i) Adopt appropriate legislative, executive
and administrative measures to align their
national laws and regulations to the
objectives of this Charter and adhere to the
values and principles contained therein;
ii) Integrate commitments, objectives,
values and principles of this Charter in
national policies and strategies;
iii) Take all necessary measures to ensure
the broader dissemination of this Charter;
iv) Undertake a coordinated effort to place
decentralisation and local development at
the centre of governance and development;
v) Demonstrate the political will, through
inter alia, the allocation of appropriate
41
resources, for the realisation of the
objectives, values and principles of this
Charter in a concrete manner; and
vi) Take the necessary steps to develop
cooperation and share experiences in the
areas of decentralisation, local governance
and local development in accordance with
the objectives, values and principles of this
Charter.
2. Implementation at Commission Level
a) Regional level
In accordance with their constitutive
instruments, Regional Economic
Communities shall:
i) Encourage Member States to ratify,
accede, implement and monitor this
Charter;
42
ii) Integrate and take into account the
objectives, principles and values of this
Charter in drafting and adopting regional
policy and legal instruments; and
iii) Support and facilitate the establishment
of an appropriate advisory regional
platform or forum for the collective voice
and action of local governments.
b) Continental level
To ensure and facilitate the implementation
of this Charter, the Commission shall:
i) Develop guidelines for the
implementation of this Charter;
ii) Facilitate the creation of favourable
conditions for good local governance and
development for the delivery of quality
public services on the continent at the local
level through the harmonisation of policies
and laws of State Parties;
43
iii) Support and facilitate the establishment
of an appropriate advisory continental
platform or forum for the collective voice
and action of local governments within the
AU framework;
iv) Assist State Parties to implement this
Charter and coordinate its evaluation;
v) Mobilise the necessary resources to
support State Parties to build their capacity
to implement this Charter; and
vi) Undertake periodic review of the
Charter and make recommendations to the
Policy Organs of the African Union.
44

articles.heading: Reporting 1. State Parties shall, from the date the Charter comes into force, submit to the
articles.text:
Commission, every three years, a Report to
the Commission on the legislative or other
measures taken with a view to giving effect
to the principles and commitments of this
Charter.
2. The Commission shall prepare and
submit to the Assembly, through the
Executive Council, a synthesised Report
on the implementation of this Charter, for
consideration.

articles.heading: Recognition, Award System and Commemoration 1. State Parties shall institutionalize a transparent and an impartial system for
articles.text:
recognizing outstanding performance,
creativity and innovation in
decentralisation, local governance and
local development.
45
2. State Parties shall promote a continental
recognition and award system to
acknowledge and emulate excellence in
decentralisation, local governance and
local development.
3. The Commission shall promote
innovative experiences and institute a
system of awards for innovation in
decentralisation, local governance and
local development.
4. State parties shall commemorate the
"Africa Day on Decentralisation and Local
Development", on the 10th of August of
each year as a means to promote the values
and principles of this Charter.
CHAPTER IV: FINAL CLAUSES
46

articles.heading: Safeguard provisions 1. The provisions of this Charter shall not be interpreted in a manner that is
articles.text:
inconsistent with the relevant principles of
international law, including international
customary law.
2. None of the provisions of this Charter
shall affect more favourable provisions
relating to decentralisation, local
governance and local development
contained in the domestic law of State
Parties or in any other regional, continental
or international agreement applicable in
these State Parties.
3. In the implementation of this Charter, the
specificities and special needs of island
states shall be taken into account.
47

articles.heading: Settlement of Disputes 1. Any dispute relating to this Charter shall be amicably resolved through direct
articles.text:
negotiations between the State Parties
concerned.
2. Where the dispute is not resolved
through direct negotiation, the State Parties
shall endeavour to resolve the dispute
through other peaceful means, including
good offices, mediation and conciliation,
or any other peaceful means agreed upon
by the State Parties. In this regard, the State
Parties shall be encouraged to make use of
the procedures and mechanisms for
resolution of disputes established within
the framework of the Union.

articles.heading: Signature, Ratification or Accession This Charter shall be open to all Member States of the Union, for signature,
articles.text:
ratification or accession, in conformity
48
with their respective constitutional
procedures.

articles.heading: Entry into Force This Charter shall enter Into force thirty (30) days after the date of the receipt by the
articles.text:
Chairperson of the Commission of the
African Union of the fifteenth (15th)
instrument of ratification.

articles.heading: Amendment 1. Any State Party may submit proposals for the amendment or revision of this Charter
articles.text:
2. Proposals for amendment or revision
shall be submitted to the Chairperson of the
Commission of the African Union, who
shall transmit the same to State Parties
within thirty (30) days of receipt thereof.
49
3. The Assembly of the Union, upon
recommendation of the Executive Council
of the Union, shall examine these proposals
at its next session, provided all State
Parties have been notified at least three (3)
months before the beginning of the session.
4. The Assembly of the Union shall adopt
the amendments in accordance with its
Rules of Procedure.
5. The amendments or revisions shall enter
into force in accordance with the
provisions of Article 24 above.

articles.heading: Depository 1. The instruments of ratification or accession shall be deposited with the Chairperson of the Commission of the
articles.text:
African Union.
2. Any State Party may withdraw from this
Charter by giving a written notice of one
(1) year in advance to the Chairperson of
the Commission of the African Union.
50
3. The Chairperson of the Commission of
the African Union shall notify the Member
States of any signature of this Charter, any
deposit of an instrument of ratification or
accession, as well as its entry into force.
4. The Chairperson of the Commission
shall also notify the State Parties of the
requests for amendments or withdrawal
from the Charter, as well as reservations
thereon.
5. Upon entry into force of this Charter, the
Chairperson of the Commission shall
register it with the Secretary-General of the
United Nations, in accordance with Article
102 of the Charter of the United Nations.
51
6. This Charter, drawn up in four (4)
original texts in the Arabic, English,
French and Portuguese languages, all four
(4) texts being equally authentic, shall be
deposited with the Chairperson of the
Commission who shall transmit a certified
true copy of the Charter to each Member
State of the African Union in its official
language.
ADOPTED BY THE TWENTY-THIRD
ORDINARY SESSION OF THE
ASSEMBLY, HELD IN MALABO,
EQUATORIAL GUINEA ON 27TH
JUNE 2014.

articles.heading: Isobanura Muri aya Masezerano, usibye bivuzwe ukundi, imvugo ikurikira ifite ibisobanuro bikurikira
articles.text:
"AU" bivuga Umuryango wa Afurika
Yunze Ubumwe;
"Inteko" bivuga Inteko y'Abakuru
b'ibihugu na Guverinoma by'Umuryango
wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe;
"Amasezerano" bivuga Amasezerano
Nyafurika yerekeye Indangagaciro
n'Amahame byo kwegereza abaturage
ubuyobozi, imiyoborere y'inzego z'ibanze
n'iterambere ry'abaturage;
"Komisiyo" bivuga Komisiyo
y’Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe;
"Amasezerano ashyiraho" bivuga
Amasezerano ashyiraho Umuryango wa
Afurika Yunze Ubumwe;
"Kwegereza abaturage ubuyobozi" bivuga
kohereza ububasha, inshingano,
ubushobozi n’umutungo biva ku rwego
rw’igihugu bijya mu nzego zose
z’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu hagamijwe
gushimangira ubushobozi bw’inzego
z’igihugu, kugira ngo abaturage
babigiremo uruhare no gutanga serivisi
nziza;
"Iterambere ry’abaturage" bivuga gushyira
hamwe umutungo, ku rwego rw’igihugu
n’urw’isi, w'abantu, w’ubukungu,
w'umuco w’abaturage, n’uwa politiki
n’uw'umutungo kamere, kuzamura no
guhindura imibereho, imiryango
y'abaturage n’uduce tw’igihugu ku rwego
rw’ibanze;
"Iterambere ry’ubukungu ku rwego
rw’ibanze" bivuga ibigize iterambere ryo
ku rwego rw’ibanze ryibanda ku gukoresha
umutungo uboneka mu gace runaka
n'ubumenyi n'ubuhanga by'ako gace mu
buryo bwo kuzana ibikorwa by’ishoramari
bigera kuri buri wese no kuzamura no
guteza imbere isaranganya ry’umutungo
mu buryo bungana;
"Imiyoborere yo ku rwego rw’ibanze"
bivuga inzira n’inzego z’imiyoborere ku
rwego rw’uduce tw’igihugu, bikubiyemo
imiyoborere n’inzego z’ibanze cyangwa
abayobozi b’inzego z'ibanze, sosiyete
sivile, n’abandi bireba bo mu nzego
z’ibanze.
"Umukozi wa Leta mu nzego z’ibanze"
bivuga uhagarariye ubutegtetsi bw’igihugu
cyangwa ubuyobozi bw’ibanze;
"Ibihugu bigize Umuryango" bivuga
ibihugu bigize Umuryango wa Afurika
Yunze Ubumwe;
"Abaminisitiri" bivuga abaminisitiri
b’ubutegetsi bwite bwa Leta cyangwa
urwego urwo ari rwo rwose rwa Leta
rushinzwe kwegereza abaturage
ubuyobozi, imiyoborere y’ubuyobozi
bw’ibanze n’iterambere ry’ahantu;
"Umuryango w’ubukungu mu karere"
bivuze guhuza uturere tw’Umuryango wa
Afurika Yunze Ubumwe;
"Igihugu kiri mu Masezerano" bivuga
igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose cyemeje
burundu cyangwa cyemeye kuba kimwe
mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
kandi cyashyikirije inyandiko zo kwemeza
burundu cyangwa zo kwemera kuba
kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho Perezida
wa Komisiyo y’Umuryango wa Afurika
Yunze Ubumwe;
"STCs" bivuga Komite tekinike zihariye
z’Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe;
"Urwego rw’uduce tw’igihugu" bivuga
inzego zose za Leta ziri munsi y’inzego
nkuru z’igihugu.

articles.heading: Intego Intego z'aya Masezerano ni
articles.text:
a) Guteza imbere, kurinda no gukora
nk'umusemburo wo kwegereza abaturage
ubuyobozi, imiyoborere y’inzego z’ibanze
n’iterambere ryo ku rwego rw’ibanze muri
Afurika;
b) Guteza imbere no gusigasira
imiyoborere yo ku rwego rw’ibanze na
demokarasi yo ku rwego rw’ibanze
nk’imwe mu nkingi zo kwegereza
abaturage ibikorwa by’ubuyobozi muri
Afurika;
c) Guteza imbere imikoreshereze
y’umutungo no guteza imbere ubukungu
bwo ku rwego rw’ibanze hagamijwe guca
ubukene muri Afurika;
d) Guteza imbere imyumvire isangiwe
hamwe n’icyerekezo rusange cy’ibihugu
bigize Umuryango ku bijyanye no
kwegereza abaturage ubuyobozi,
imiyoborere yo ku rwego rw’ ibanze
n’iterambere ryo ku rwego rw’ibanze;
e) Guteza imbere indangagaciro
n’amahame by’ibanze byo kwegereza
abaturage ibikorwa by’ubuyobozi,
imiyoborere yo ku rwego rw’ibanze
n’iterambere ryo ku rwego rw’ibanze;
f) Gutegura ishyirwaho, ishyira mu
bikorwa, kugenzura no gusuzuma politiki
zo kwegereza abaturage ubuyobozi,
imiyoborere yo ku rwego rw'ibanze,
n’iterambere ryo ku rwego rw’ibanze, ku
rwego rw’umugabane, urw’akarere,
rw’igihugu n’urw’uduce tw’ibihugu;
g) Gushishikariza ubufatanye, guhuza no
gusangira ubumenyi mu bihugu bigize
Umuryango no mu miryango ihuza
ubukungu bw'ibihugu byo mu karere ku
bijyanye no kwegereza abaturage
ubuyobozi, imiyoborere y’inzego z’ibanze
n'iterambere ryo ku rwego rw’ibanze;
h) Guteza imbere gushyira hamwe
n’ubufatanye by’inzego z’ibanze cyangwa
abayobozi b’inzego z'ibanze ku nzego
z'ibanze, iz'igihugu, iz'akarere ndetse
n'umugabane; no
i) Guteza imbere sosiyete sivile, urwego
rw'abikorera n'abaturage kugira uruhare
mu bikorwa byo kwegerezwa abaturage
ubuyobozi, imiyoborere y'inzego z’ibanze
n'ibikorwa by'iterambere byo ku rwego
rw’ibanze.

articles.heading: Ibirebwa n’aya Masezerano Aya Masezerano areba
Gutangira gukurikizwa Iri teka ritangira gukurikizwa ku munsi ritangarijweho mu Igazeti ya Leta ya
articles.text:
Repubulika y’u Rwanda.
Kigali, 31/10/2023
IRANGASHINGIRO
Twebwe, Ibihugu bigize Umuryango wa
Afurika Yunze Ubumwe (AU):
TUYOBOWE n’intego n'amahame
bikubiye mu Masezerano mpuzamahanga
ashyiraho Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze
Ubumwe, cyane cyane ingingo ya 3 n’iya
4, bishimangira akamaro k’imiyoborere
myiza, uruhare rw’abaturage, kugendera
ku mategeko n’uburenganzira bwa muntu;
TUGENDEYE ku Itangazo rya Yaoundé
ryemejwe n'Abaminisitiri ba Afurika
bashinzwe kwegereza abaturage
ubuyobozi n'iterambere ry'abaturage ku wa
29 Ukwakira 2005;
TWIBUTSA Icyemezo cy'Inama Nyobozi
ya AU EX.CL./Dec.677 (XX) cyatorewe i
Addis Abeba, muri Etiyopiya ku wa 28
Mutarama 2012 nk'uko cyemejwe n'Inteko
y'abakuru b'ibihugu na guverinoma
kijyanye no guteza imbere Amasezerano
Nyafurika yerekeye Indangagaciro,
Amahame n'ibigenderwaho byo kwegereza
abaturage ubuyobozi n’iterambere
ry’inzego z'ibanze;
TUGENDEYE ku cyerekezo
cy’Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze
Ubumwe, Afurika ihuriweho, itera imbere
kandi ifite amahoro, iyoborwa n’abaturage
bayo kandi igaragaza imbaraga zikomeye
mu ruhando rw’isi;
TWIBUTSA Amasezerano Nyafurika
yerekeye Uburenganzira bwa Muntu
n’ubw’Abaturage (1981), Amasezerano
y’Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe
yerekeye gukumira no kurwanya ruswa
(2003), Amasezerano Nyafurika yerekeye
Demokarasi, Amatora n’Imiyoborere
(2007), Amasezerano Nyafurika yerekeye
Indangagaciro n’Amahame y’Imirimo ya
Leta n'Ubuyobozi (2011);
TUZIRIKANA uruhare rw’imiryango yo
mu karere, Ibihugu bigize Umuryango,
amashyirahamwe y’inzego z’ibanze,
imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta
n’abayobozi gakondo mu guteza imbere,
kurinda, gukomeza no gushimangira
kwegereza abaturage ibikorwa
by’ubuyobozi, imiyoborere n'iterambere
by'abaturage;
TWIYEMEJE guteza imbere
indangagaciro n’amahame yo kwegereza
abaturage ubuyobozi, imiyoborere
n’iterambere ry’abaturage muri Afurika
nk’uburyo bwo kuzamura imibereho
y’abaturage bose ku mugabane;
TWIYUMVISHA ko inzego z'ibanze
cyangwa abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze ari
ishingiro rw'imiyoborere ishingiye kuri
demokarasi;
TWONGEYE KWEMEZA ubushake
bwacu bwo gukomeza demokarasi
igirwamo uruhare, guha ubushobozi
abaturage n'imiryango y’abaturage; guteza
imbere ibijyanye no kubazwa inshingano
no gukorera mu mucyo mu nzego za Leta,
guteza imbere no kurinda urusobe
rw'imico, no guteza imbere uburinganire
bushingiye ku gitsina n’ukureshya
kw’ibisekuruza ku rwego rw'igihugu
cyangwa urw'agace k’igihugu;
TWIYEMEZA guharanira ko abantu bose
bo ku mugabane babona serivisi z'ibanze;
TUZIRIKANA uburyo butandukanye
bwo kwegereza abaturage ubuyobozi,
harimo iyoherezwa ry’ububasha mu nzego
z’ibanze, kuhohereza inshingano mu nzego
z’ibanze no guha inshingano mu nzego za
politiki, iz'ubuyobozi n'iz'imari;
Twemeranyije ibi bikurikira:
UMUTWE WA I: ISOBANURA,
INTEGO, IBIREBWA
N’AMASEZERANO
N'INDANGAGACIRO

articles.heading: Ubuyobozi bw'inzego z'ibanze 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishyiraho amategeko/amabwiriza
articles.text:
y’imbere mu gihugu, ateganya inzego
zitandukanye za Leta zifite inshingano zo
gukoresha ububasha bwazo binyuze mu
buryo bw’amategeko bwasobanuwe neza.
2. Inzego za Leta cyangwa inzego
z’ibanze, hakurikijwe amategeko
y’igihugu, zifite ububasha, mu buryo bwo
kubazwa inshingano n’ubwo kunyuza
ibintu mu mucyo, bwo gucunga ubuyobozi
n’imari byazo binyuze mu nteko zifata
ibyemezo n’inzego nyobozi byatowe mu
buryo bwa demokarasi
3. Imipaka y'uturere tugenzurwa n'inzego
za Leta cyangwa inzego z’ibanze tugomba
guhindurwa hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n’itegeko.
4. Inzego za Leta cyangwa inzego z'ibanze
zigomba kugishwa inama binyuze mu
mabwiriza asobanutse neza ajyanye
n'inyandiko z'amategeko zo ku rwego
rw'igihugu cyangwa iz'ibanze, politiki
z'urwego runaka, gahunda cyangwa
imishinga igira ingaruka ku bubasha
bwazo mu buryo butaziguye cyangwa
buziguye kugira ngo zigire ubushobozi
bwo guhigndura imibereho y'abaturage
b’ako gace.

articles.heading: Ubufasha 1. Inzego za Leta zishyiraho uburyo butuma gufata ibyemezo, gushyiraho politiki na gahunda, kuyemeza no
articles.text:
kuyishyira mu bikorwa ku nzego z’ibanze
za Leta aho inzego za Leta cyangwa inzego
z'ibanze zitanga icyizere cyo gukora neza
cyane.
2. Inzego nkuru za Leta zishyiraho uburyo
butuma habaho ubufatanye no guhuza
ibikorwa hagati y'inzego za Leta zo ku
rwego rw'igihugu n'iz'ibanze, kandi ziha
inzego za Leta cyangwa inzego z'ibanze
ububasha bwo gukora imirimo
n'inshingano byazo.
3. Inzego za Leta cyangwa inzego z’ibanze
zifatanya n’inzego nkuru za Leta n’abandi
bayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze kugira ngo
ibikorwa bya Leta mu gutanga serivisi za
Leta birusheho kuba ingirakamaro kandi
bigire ingaruka nziza.

articles.heading: Gukusanya umutungo no guteza imbere ubukungu bw’igihugu 1. Inzego za Leta nkuru zo zishyiraho
articles.text:
amategeko, ingamba kandi zigashyiraho
uburyo bukwiye bwo guha inzego z’ibanze
ububasha bwo gukoresha no guha
umutungo inzego z’ibanze hagamijwe
iterambere ry’ubukungu bw’igihugu.
2. Inzego nkuru za Leta zishyiraho
amategeko kandi zigashyiraho uburyo
bukenewe bwo kugenzura no gusuzuma
kugira ngo ijanisha ry’amafaranga yinjira
ku nzego z’igihugu n’iz’ibanze agezwe mu
buryo bukwiye mu nzego z’ibanze
cyangwa mu nzego z’ibanze za Leta
hagamijwe iterambere ry’inzego z’ibanze.
3. Inzego nkuru za Leta zikorana bya hafi
n’inzego z’ibanze cyangwa inzego
z’ubuyobozi mu guteza imbere urwego
rw’abikorera n’ishoramari cyangwa
ibikorwa ry’iterambere ry’abaturage
binyuze mu nzego z’amategeko, iz’imari
n’iz’inzego.
4. Inzego z’ibanze za Leta, cyangwa
inzego z’ubuyobozi z’ibanze zigomba,
hakurikijwe amategeko, kandi mu buryo
bwo kubazwa inshingano kandi bukorera
mu mucyo, kuzamura, gucunga no
kugenzura umutungo uboneka mu duce
zifiteho ububasha zigishije inama inzego
nkuru za Leta, sosiyete sivili n’urwego
rw’abikorera binyuze mu buryo
bw’amategeko, bw’inzego no mu buryo
bw'ubufatanye bwashyizweho mu buryo
busobanutse kanbugengwa n'amategeko.
5. Inzego z’ibanze za Leta cyangwa inzego
z’ibanze z’ubuyobozi zigomba
gushishikariza no gukora ku buryo sosiyete
sivili, urwego rw’abikorera, abaturage,
ibigo byo ku rwego rw’igihugu n’ibyo ku
rwego rw’uduce tw’igihugu byishyura
imisoro n’amafaranga akoreshwa ku rwego
rw’agace zifitemo ububasha binyuze mu
buryo busobanutse, buciye mu mucyo
kandi bunoze.

articles.heading: Ubusobekerane n’itandukaniro Bitabangamiye ukubahiriza aya Masezerano
articles.text:
1. Inzego z'ibanze cyangwa inzego
z’ubutegetsi zikoresha ububasha bwazo
hitawe ku bintu bifatika, indangagaciro,
n’imico y’ahantu n'amahame, amategeko
n'ibipimo ngenderwaho by'igihugu.
2. Hakurikijwe amategeko, gahunda,
imishinga cyangwa ibikorwa byo mu
gihugu bishyirwa mu bikorwa hagishijwe
inama abafatanyabikorwa kandi bigakorwa
mu buryo bwo guha agaciro urusobe
rw’imico, amadini n’uburinganire
bw’abagore n’abagabo mu bice byo mu
mijyi no mu cyaro.
3. Inzego nkuru z’igihugu n’inzego
z’ibanze zishobora gushyiraho uburyo bwo
kugisha inama, zishingiye ku miterere yo
mu gace k’igihugu, kugira ngo zitange
ibyifuzo cyangwa zitange ibitekerezo
byerekeye amabwiriza cyangwa
imyanzuro irebana n'iterambere ry'imbere
mu gihugu.
Icyakora, uruhare rw'abayobozi b’inzego
z'ibanze batowe rukomeza kuba
urw’ingenzi.

articles.heading: Amategeko 1. Inzego z’ibanze zishyiraho amategeko, kandi zishyira mu bikorwa gahunda, imishinga cyangwa ingamba zigenzura mu
articles.text:
buryo buhuje n'amategeko n'amabwiriza
by'igihugu.
2. Ibihugu biri mu Masezerano na politiki
ku rwego rw’akarere ku rwego
rw’umugabane na/cyangwa ku rwego
rw’isi bifasha kandi bikamenya ko inzego
z'ibanze zubahiriza ayo mategeko
n'amasezerano ku rwego rw ibanze.

articles.heading: Ukudaheza, Ukureshya n'Uburinganire 1. Inzego z’imiyoborere y’igihugu cyangwa inzego z'ibanze zikorera
articles.text:
inshingano n'imirimo byazo mu buryo
budaheza, burangwa n'ukureshya kandi
buha abaturage bose bo mu gace k’igihugu
uburyo bungana bwo kubona serivisi nziza.
2. Inzego z’imiyoborere y’igihugu
cyangwa abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze
bagomba kumenya ko amatsinda
y’abasigajwe inyuma n’amateka
n’abaturage bakennye bo mu cyaro no mu
mijyi bagomba kubigiramo uruhare kandi
bagashyirwa imbere mu itangwa rya
serivisi.
3. Inzego z’imiyoborere y’igihugu
cyangwa inzego z’ibanze zigomba
gushyiraho ingamba zita ku bakene kandi
zikita cyane cyane ku bagore n’urubyiruko,
ndetse n’imiryango itishoboye harimo
ariko itagarukira gusa ku bageze mu
zabukuru, abafite ubumuga, ingo zanduye
virusi itera SIDA, ingo ziyobowe n’abana,
abana bo mu muhanda, abatishoboye,
abatazi gusoma, kwandika, abatuye mu
tujagari tw’imijyi, ingo zikennye zo mu
cyaro, abashomeri n' abafite akazi
kadahamye, impunzi, abatagira aho baba,
abimuwe muri gahunda cyangwa mu
mushinga ugamije iterambere, ishyirwa
mu bikorwa no gutanga serivisi.
4. Ubuyobozi bw’inzego z’ibanze
cyangwa abayobozi b’inzego z'ibanze
ntibagomba gukora ivangura rishingiye ku
gitsina, imyaka, ubumuga, urwego
rw'imibereho, idini, aho umuntu akomoka,
ubwoko cyangwa inkomoko y’uruhu,
ururimi cyangwa ibitekerezo bya politiki
mu rwego rwo gukora inshingano zabo,
gushyiraho politiki, gutegura, gushyira mu
bikorwa, kugenzura no gusuzuma gahunda
cyangwa imishinga.
5. Ubuyobozi bw’inzego z’ibanze
cyangwa abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze
bugomba gukora inshingano n’imirimo
bwazo mu bijyanye n’iterambere rirambye,
rikubiyemo iterambere ry’ibinyejana
by’ahazaza, iterambere rihuza ibisekuruza
ndetse no kubungabunga ibidukikije.

articles.heading: Inshingano zisangiwe no kuzuzanya Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bikora ku buryo
articles.text:
a) Inzego z'ibanze cyangwa abayobozi
b'inzego z'ibanze zikora ibikorwa byo
guhindura no gusigasira imibereho
y'abaturage n'ibidukikije by’agace
zigenzura.
b) Ubuyobozi bw’inzego z’ibanze
cyangwa abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze,
hashingiwe ku mikoranire myiza y’inzego
z’ibanze n’inzego nkuru, zigira uruhare mu
bikorwa byose by’igihugu, byo ku duce
tw’igihugu, abikorera ku giti cyabo ndetse
n’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta mu
iterambere no mu gushyira mu bikorwa
gahunda z’iterambere ry’agace zigenzura,
kandi zigakora ku buryo zihuzwa na
politiki y’iterambere ry’igihugu,
ry’akarere cyangwa ry’umugabane.
c) Inzego z'ibanze cyangwa abayobozi
b'inzego z'ibanze bagaragaza gahunda
z’iterambere zo ku rwego rw’ibanze mu
rwego rw’ubufatanye mu bikorwa,
nk’amasezerano yo kwiyemeza, aba
azemezwa n’abafatanyabikorwa bose
bireba.
d) Inzego nkuru n’inzego z’ibanze
cyangwa inzego z’ubuyobozi bisabwa
n’amategeko, gushyiraho uburyo
bw’imikoranire no gufashanya kugira ngo
zigere ku ntego z'iterambere ry'isi,
ry'umugabane, ry'akarere, ry'igihugu n'iryo
ku rwego rw’ibanze.
e) Zishyiraho uburyo bw’ubufatanye
hagati y’inzego zishinzwe iterambere
ry’igihugu, ibigo bya Leta, abikorera na
sosiyete sivili n’inzego z'ibanze, mu rwego
rwo gushyigikira ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ry'ibyihutirwa by'iterambere ry'akarere.
f) Inzego z’ibanze cyangwa inzego
z’ubuyobozi zifite inshingano ku baturage
zijyanye n'ibyemezo na politiki
by'iterambere ry'ahantu zigenzura,
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'ibyo byemezo na
politiki no gucunga umutungo w'imari. Ku
bw’ibyo, inshingano z'abaturage zigomba
gusobanurwa neza mu rwego rwo
koroshya ubufatanye n'inzego z'ibanze
cyangwa inzego z’ubuyobozi.
g) Inzego z’ibanze cyangwa inzego
z’ubuyobozi, hakurikijwe amategeko
y'igihugu kandi mu rwego rw’ubuyobozi
bwiza bw'ubufatanye, zigenzurwa na
guverinoma n’abaturage mu bijyanye no
gukora imirimo yazo n’inshingano no
gushyira mu bikorwa gahunda, imishinga
cyangwa politiki.

articles.heading: Kugira uruhare 1. Amategeko y'igihugu ateganya uburenganzira n'inshingano by'abaturage mu kugira uruhare mu buzima rusange ku
articles.text:
rwego rw'inzego z’ibanze.
2. Demokarasi ni yo shingiro
ry’imiyoborere y’inzego z'ibanze kandi
igira uruhare rutuma habaho uburyo bwo
kugira uruhare no guhagararirwa.
3. Inzego z’ibanze cyangwa inzego
z’ubuyobozi ziteza imbere uruhare
rw'ibyiciro byose by'abaturage mu
gutegura, gushyira mu bikorwa, kugenzura
no gusuzuma politiki, gahunda n'imishinga
binyuze mu buryo bw'amahuriro
y'abaturage n'ubundi buryo bwo kugira
uruhare hagamijwe gutanga serivisi nziza.
4. Inzego z'ibanze cyangwa abayobozi
b'inzego z'ibanze bateza imbere iterambere
ry’ibikorwa bigezweho bya demokarasi
n'amahoro.
5. Inzego z’ibanze cyangwa abayobozi
b’inzego z’ibanze zishyiraho ingamba
zituma habaho uruhare rugaragara
rw'abaturage, sosiyete sivile n'abandi
bafatanyabikorwa mu miyoborere
n'iterambere by'uduce tw’igihugu.
6. Inzego nkuru za Leta, ku bufatanye
n’inzego z’ibanze cyangwa inzego
z’ibanze z’ubuyobozi, zishobora gutumira
kandi zishishikariza uruhare rusesuye rwa
diyasipora nyafurika mu guteza imbere
ibijyanye no kwegereza abaturage
ubuyobozi, imiyoborere yo ku rwego
rw’ibanze n’iterambere ryo ku rwego
rw’ibanze binyuze muri politiki n’uburyo
byasobanuwe neza.
7. Amategeko y’igihugu ashyirwaho
kugira ngo yongere imbaraga kandi
ashishikarize inzego z’ibanze gushyiraho
uburyo bukwiye bwo kugira uruhare
kw’abaturage, inshingano mboneragihugu
n’ubundi buryo bwo gutanga ibitekerezo.

articles.heading: Guhagararirwa 1. Amatora y’abakozi ba Leta b’inzego z’ibanze ashyirwa mu rwego rw’amategeko y’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
articles.text:
Masezerano, asobanura neza uburyo
bukoreshwa mu matora n’igihe ntarengwa
azakorerwaho.
2. Inzego nkuru za Leta zishyiraho
amategeko y’amatora ateza imbere
amatora y’inzego z’ibanze asanzwe,
akurikije inzira za demokarasi, mu
bwisanzure, mu butabera no mu mucyo.
3. Inzego nkuru za Leta zishyiraho
ingamba zidasanzwe n’uburyo bukwiye
kugira ngo habeho uruhare rusesuye
rw’abaturage bose bujuje ibisabwa, harimo
n’ingamba zihariye zo guhagararira
abagore n'amatsinda y'abantu batishoboye
mu matora y'inzego z'ibanze mu rwego
rw'amategeko y'igihugu.
4. Abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze bagomba
guhagararira mu buryo bukwiye inyungu
z’abaturage kandi bakagisha inama
abaturage babo ku buryo buhoraho kandi
buri gihe binyuze mu buryo n’igihe
byateganyijwe neza.
5. Inzego nkuru za Leta zishyiraho
amategeko kandi zishyiraho uburyo
bw’imiyoborere n’imari kandi zikoresha
ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho
n’itangazabumenyi (ICT) kugira ngo
zishishikarize abaturage b’agace zishinzwe
n’imiryango y’abaturage gutanga
ibitekerezo ku babahagarariye ku rwego
rw’ibanze batowe, kumva ibibazo byabo
no kubikemura.

articles.heading: Gukorera mu mucyo, kubazwa inshingano n’imyitwarire ikwiye 1. Ingamba zo guteza imbere gukorera mu
articles.text:
mucyo no kubazwa inshingano z’inzego
z’ibanze zigaragazwa neza mu mategeko
y’igihugu. Ayo mategeko asobanura neza
uruhare n’inshingano z’inzego zo ku
rwego rw’igihugu n’izo ku rwego
rw’uduce tw’igihugu, ibigo bya Leta,
abatanga serivisi, abayobozi batowe
n’abashyizwe mu buyobozi, n’imiryango
itegamiye kuri Leta.
2. Inzego nkuru n'iz’ibanze cyangwa
inzego z'ibanze zishyiraho gahunda zo
kugira uruhare kw'abaturage no gushyiraho
uburyo bwo gutanga amakuru mu
miyoborere y’inzego z’ibanze n'iterambere
ry’inzego z'ibanze binyuze mu gutangaza
raporo z'ibikorwa bya buri mwaka
by'inzego z'ibanze no gutangaza inyandiko
z'imari mu buryo bwuzuye.
3. Inzego nkuru n’inzego z’ibanze
cyangwa inzego z’ubuyobozi zishyiraho
uburyo bwose bwo kurwanya ruswa.
4. Inzego nkuru za Leta n’iz'ibanze
cyangwa inzego z’ubuyobozi zigomba
gushyiraho uburyo burangwa n’udushya
bwo gukemura ibibazo by'ibirego mu
rwego rwo guteza imbere no kurinda
gutanga amakuru ajyanye n'uburyo bwose
bw'imyitwarire n'imikorere y'uburiganya,
harimo ruswa, ikimenyane n'icyenewabo,
ndetse no gukemura ibibazo.
5. Abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze bagomba
kwerekana imyitwarire
n'ubunyangamugayo mu kurangiza
inshingano zabo.
6. Inzego nkuru zishyiraho amategeko
kandi zigashyiraho uburyo bwo kugenzura
amahame agenga imyitwarire ikwiye ku
nzego z’ibanze cyangwa abayobozi
b’inzego z’ibanze.

articles.heading: Kwita ku buringanire, ku rubyiruko no ku bumuga 1. Inzego z’ibanze cyangwa inzego z’ubuyobozi bw’ibanze zigomba gushyira
articles.text:
imbere ibijyanye n'uburinganire,
urubyiruko n'abantu bafite ubumuga mu
buryo bwose bwo gukora politiki, gutegura
iterambere no gutanga serivisi, kimwe no
gushyira mu bikorwa, kugenzura no
gusuzuma gahunda n'imishinga
y'iterambere.
2. Inzego z’ibanze cyangwa inzego
z’ubuyobozi bw’ibanze zigomba guteza
imbere no guharanira uruhare rw’umugore
n’urubyiruko, n’abantu bafite ubumuga mu
buzima rusange, ubuyobozi n’imyanya
y’ubuyobozi ku bibazo byose bijyanye
n’imiyoborere n’iterambere ryo ku rwego
rw’ibanze.
3. Inzego z’ibanze cyangwa abayobozi
b’inzego z’ibanze zigomba guteza imbere
no kongera uruhare rw’abagore,
urubyiruko n’abafite ubumuga mu bibazo
byose bijyanye n’imiyoborere
n’iterambere ryo ku rwego rw’ibanze.

articles.heading: Imikorere myiza 1. Ubuyobozi bw'inzego z'ibanze a) Amategeko y’igihugu ashyirwaho kugira ngo ahe ubuyobozi bw'inzego
articles.text:
z'ibanze ububasha bwo kugena no gucunga
imitunganyirize e y'inzego z'ibanze za Leta
mu butegetsi bw'igihugu mu rwego
rw’igihugu rw’amategeko rusange
hagamijwe guha abaturage serivisi nziza
kandi bafitiye ubushobozi.
b) Inzego z'ibanze cyangwa inzego
z’ubuyobozi bw’ibanze zigaragaza kandi
zishyira mu bikorwa uburyo bushya bwo
gutanga serivisi ku baturage b’igihugu mu
rwego rw'amategeko y'igihugu.
2. Gukusanya no gukoresha umutungo
a) Inzego z’ibanze zihabwa umutungo
usabwa w’abantu, w’imari
n’uw’ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo zikore
neza inshingano zazo kandi mu buryo
bukwiye.
b) Ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho
n’itangazabumenyi (ICT) rigomba
kugaragazwa kandi rigakoreshwa neza
kugira ngo imiyoborere yo ku rwego
rw’ibanze n’iterambere ryo ku rwego
rw’ibanze birusheho kugenda neza kandi
mu buryo bukwiye.
3.Kongera ubushobozi
a) Inzego z'ibanze cyangwa inzego
abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze, kimwe
n'amashyirahamwe y'inzego z'ibanze,
bifata ingamba zihamye kandi zihoraho zo
guteza imbere ubushobozi hagamijwe
kuzamura imikorere y'abahagarariye
abaturage n’abayobozi batowe ku rwego
rw’ibanze kugira ngo basohoze neza
imirimo n’inshingano zabo neza kandi mu
buryo bukwiye.
b) Inzego nkuru za Leta zishyiraho ibigo
by’abakozi ba Leta, zigashyiraho gahunda
zidasanzwe kandi zigategura
integanyanyigisho zidasanzwe ku nzego
z’ibanze n’ubuyobozi bw’ibanze.
c) Inzego nkuru za Leta zishishikariza
ingamba zo gusangira ubunararibonye
n’imigirire myiza ku rwego rw’ibihugu
bibiri, urw’akarere n’urw’umugabane.
d) Imiryango y’abaturage, sosiyete sivile
hamwe n’abaturage bagira inyungu mu
guteza imbere ubushobozi kugira ngo
bagire uruhare runini mu nzego z’ibanze
n’iterambere ryo ku rwego rw’ibanze.
e) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
biteza imbere ibikorwa byo gukora
igenzura ku bushake muri byo no hagati
yabyo.
4. Imitungo kamere
a) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bishyiraho amategeko y’igihugu kandi
bigashyiraho uburyo bukubiyemo inzego
z’ibanze, sosiyete sivile n’abaturage babyo
kugira ngo habeho kurengera bihagije no
gukoresha neza umutungo kamere ku
rwego rw’ibanze.
b) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bishyiraho amategeko y’igihugu kandi
bigashyiraho gahunda ikubiyemo
ubuyobozi bw’inzego z’ibanze, sosiyete
sivile, n’abaturage babyo kugira ngo
abaturage babyo babone inyungu ku
mutungo kamere ukoreshwa mu baturage
babyo.
c) Inzego nkuru za Leta zifite inshingano
zo gusaranganya ku buryo bukwiye inzego
zose z’uturere tw’igihugu ndetse
n’imiryango y’abaturage inyungu ziva mu
ikoreshwa ry’umutungo kamere mu turere
tw’igihugu no mu baturage.
5. Gutera inkunga inzego z’ibanze,
imicungire y'imari n'iterambere ry'uduce
tw’igihugu
a) Inzego nkuru za Leta zishyiraho
amategeko y’igihugu aharanira guha
inzego z’ibanze inshingano zose zo
gucunga umutungo w’imari ku rwego
rw'ibanze.
b) Inzego nkuru zigomba, binyuze mu
bufasha n'ubugenzuzi bukwiye, gukora ku
buryo umutungo w'imari wagenwe
ukoreshwe neza kandi mu buryo bwiza,
bitabaye ngombwa ko bihungabanya
ihame ry'ubwigenge bw'agace k’ibanze mu
by'imari.
c) Amategeko y’igihugu ashyirwaho
kugira ngo habeho gushyigikira imari
y’inzego z’ibanze.
d) Inzego nkuru za Leta zigomba
gusobanura umutungo w’inzego z’ibanze
kimwe n’uburyo bwo kohereza
amafaranga bugira ibyo busaba
n’ubutagira ibyo busaba.
e) Uburyo bwo kohereza amafaranga
bugira ibyo busaba n’ubutagira ibyo
busaba akomotse ku nzego nkuru
z’igihugu ajya ku nzego z’ibanze cyangwa
ku bayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze bugomba
gukorwa mu mucyo kandi bukaba
buteganyijwe.
f) Ibisabwa kugira ngo inzego z’ibanze
zibone inguzanyo, amasoko y’imari,
n’ubufasha mu iterambere biteganywa
n’amategeko.
g) Inzego z’ibanze zishyiraho uburyo
bw'ibaruramari, ubugenzuzi n'imiyoborere
mu rwego rwo gucunga neza umutungo
w'imari mu buryo bukwiye, bwujuje
ubuziranenge kandi bwubahiriza
amategeko, amahame n'ibipimo
by'ibaruramari by'igihugu.
h) Inzego z'ibanze n’abayobozi zigomba
kugaragaza no gushyiraho uburyo n'inzira
zo gukoresha mu buryo butanga umusaruro
cyangwa gukoresha neza umutungo
w'amafaranga mu itangwa rya serivisi
nziza nk'uko biteganywa n’amategeko.

articles.heading: Ubufatanye, Ubutwererane n'imikoranire 1. Amategeko y’igihugu ashyirwaho kugira ngo agenzure amategeko ashobora
articles.text:
gutuma inzego z’ibanze zigirana
imikoranire cyangwa ubufatanye n’inzego
z’ibanze z’ibindi bihugu bya Afurika
kugira ngo zigere ku iterambere rusange
ry’inzego z’ibanze, ry’igihugu
n’iry’akarere ndetse n’intego z’ubufatanye
bw’umugabane.
2. Inzego z’ibanze cyangwa abayobozi
bw’inzego z’ibanze zishobora kugirana
ubufatanye bukwiye n’inzego z’ibanze
zitari iz’ibihugu bya Afurika kugira ngo
bateze imbere ubufatanye, cyane cyane
ubufatanye bw’ibihugu biherereye mu
muhora w’amajyepfo.
3. Amategeko y’igihugu ashyirwaho
kugira ngo yemerere uburenganzira
bw’inzego z’ibanze gushyiraho
ishyirahamwe ry’igihugu rishinzwe
ubufatanye n’imikoranire.
4. Iryo shyirahamwe ry’igihugu rigengwa
n’amategeko rusange kandi ryinjizwa muri
gahunda y’imicungire y’ibigo yo
kwegereza abaturage ibikorwa by’inzego
z’ubuyobozi.
5. Inzego z’ibanze cyangwa
amashyirahamwe y’inzego z'ibanze ku
rwego rw’igihugu bifite uburenganzira
bwo kwinjira mu mashyirahamwe
y’inzego z’ibanze, ku rwego rw’akarere,
urw’umugabane n’urw’isi.
6. Inzego nkuru z’ubuyobozi zigomba
gushishikariza, gushyigikira no guharanira
uruhare rusesuye rw’amashyirahamwe
y’inzego z’ibanze nk’ijwi rusange
ry’inzego z’ibanze mu bijyanye
n’iterambere cyangwa ibyemezo
by’igihugu, iby’akarere n’iby’umugabane.
7. Inzego nkuru zigomba gushyigikira no
gufasha imikorere yigenga kandi ikwiye
y’amashyirahamwe y’inzego z'ibanze.
8. Gahunda yo kwishyira hamwe
kw'akarere iteza imbere ubufatanye
bw'inzego z'ibanze cyangwa abayobozi
binzego z’ibanze hagati y'ibihugu bigize
Umuryango; ingamba z'ubufatanye
bwambukiranya imipaka zishyirwaho
n'ibihugu bigize Umuryango n'imiryango
y'ubukungu ihuza ibihugu byo mu karere.
9. Inzego nkuru z’ubuyobozi zigomba
gushyigikira inzego z’ibanze mu kugira
uruhare rugaragara mu bikorwa, uburyo na
gahunda ku rwego rw’akarere
n’urw’umugabane.
UMUTWE WA III: UBURYO
BUKORESHWA MU ISHYIRWA MU
BIKORWA

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo gukurikirana Mu rwego rwo gushyira mu bikorwa ibiteganywa muri aya Masezerano,
articles.text:
ibikorwa bikurikira bikorerwa mu nzego
zikurikira:
1. Ishyirwa mu bikorwa ku rwego rwa buri
gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
a) Ku rwego rw’Inzego z'ibanze
Inzego z'ibanze cyangwa abayobozi
b’inzego z’ibanze:
i) Zifite kandi inshingano no kubazwa
n'abaturage bo mu turere zikoreramo
ibijyanye n'ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'intego
z'aya Masezerano, no kubahiriza
indangagaciro n'amahame byayo;
ii) Gufatanya n’inzego nkuru n’izindi
nzego z’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu kugira ngo
hashyirwe mu bikorwa intego rusange
z'iterambere;
iii) Kugira uruhare mu mashyirahamwe
y’inzego z’ibanze mu gihugu no gufatanya
na sosiyete sivile n’abikorera hagamijwe
kugera ku ntego z’aya Masezerano;
iv) Kugaragaza ubushake bwa politiki bwo
kuvuganira no guharanira ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ry’intego, indangagaciro
n'amahame by'aya Masezerano hamwe
n’inzego nkuru z’igihugu;
v) Kwiyemeza gushyiraho uburyo bwiza
bwo gukwirakwiza no gushyira mu
bikorwa aya Masezerano; no
vi) Kwiyemeza kugira uruhare mu
gukurikirana, gusuzuma no gutanga raporo
y'ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'aya Masezerano.
b) Urwego rw’inzego nkuru
Kugira ngo habeho kandi horoshywe
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'aya Masezerano,
ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bigomba:
i) Kwemeza ingamba nshingamategeko,
nyubahirizategeko n’iz’ubuyobozi
bikwiye kugira ngo bihuze amategeko
n'amabwiriza y'igihugu n’intego z'aya
Masezerano kandi hubahirizwe
indangagaciro n'amahame bikubiyemo;
ii) Guhuza ibyo byiyemeje, intego,
indangagaciro n'amahame y'aya
Masezerano muri politiki n'ingamba
by'igihugu;
iii) Gufata ingamba zose zikenewe mu
rwego rwo gukwirakwiza byagutse aya
Masezerano;
iv) Gufata ingamba zihamye zo gushyiraho
gahunda yo kwegereza abaturage
ubuyobozi n'iterambere ryo ku rwego
rw’ibanze mu kigo gishinzwe imiyoborere
n'iterambere;
v) Kugaragaza ubushake bwa politiki,
binyuze cyane cyane, mu gutanga
umutungo ukwiye, kugira ngo intego,
indangagaciro n'amahame by'aya
Masezerano bigerweho mu buryo bufatika;
no
vi) Gufata ingamba zikenewe zo guteza
imbere ubufatanye no gusangira
ubunararibonye mu bijyanye no kwegereza
abaturage ubuyobozi, imiyoborere yo ku
rwego rw’ibanze n’iterambere ryo ku
rwego rw’ibanze hakurikijwe intego,
indangagaciro n'amahame by'aya
Masezerano.
2. Ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryo ku rwego rwa
Komisiyo
a) Urwego rw'akarere
Hakurikijwe amategeko yabyo,
Umuryango w’ubukungu uhuza ibihugu
by’akarere ugomba:
i) Gushishikariza ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano kwemeza burundu, kwemeza
kuba kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho,
gushyira mu bikorwa no gukurikirana aya
Masezerano;
ii) Gushyira mu bikorwa no kuzirikana
intego, amahame n'indangagaciro by’aya
Masezerano mu gutegura no gushyiraho
politiki y'akarere n'inyandiko z'amategeko;
no
iii) Gushyigikira no koroshya ishyirwaho
ry'urubuga cyangwa ihuriro
by'ubujyanama ku rwego rw’akarere
rukwiriye kugira ngo ubuyobozi
bw’inzego z'ibanze bugire ijwi rimwe
kandi bukorere hamwe.
b) Urwego rw’umugabane
Mu rwego rwo guharanira no koroshya
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'aya Masezerano,
Komisiyo igomba:
i) Gushyiraho amabwiriza akurikizwa mu
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'aya Masezerano ;
ii) Koroshya ishyirwaho ry’imiyoborere
myiza y’inzego z’ibanze n’iterambere
ry’itangwa rya serivisi nziza za Leta ku
mugabane ku rwego rw'akarere binyuze
mu guhuza politiki n'amategeko y'ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano;
iii) Gushyigikira no koroshya ishyirwaho
ry’urwego cyangwa ihuriro rikwiye
rishinzwe ubujyanama ku rwego
rw’umugabane hagamijwe kugira ngo
inzego z’ibanze zigire ijwi rimwe no
gukora ibikorwa by'ubufatanye mu rwego
rw'Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze
Ubumwe;
iv) Gufasha ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano gushyira mu bikorwa aya
Masezerano no guhuza ibikorwa byayo
by’isuzuma;
v) Gukusanya umutungo ukenewe wo
gufasha ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano kubaka ubushobozi bwabyo
hagamijwe gushyira mu bikorwa aya
Masezerano; no
vi) Gukora isuzuma ngarukagihe
ry'Amasezerano no gutanga ibyifuzonama
ku nzego za Politiki z'Umuryango wa
Afurika Yunze Ubumwe.

articles.heading: Gutanga raporo 1. Guhera ku itariki aya Masezerano atangiriye gukurikizwa, buri myaka itatu,
articles.text:
ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bishyikiriza Komisiyo raporo igaragaza
ingamba z'amategeko cyangwa izindi
ngamba zafashwe mu rwego rwo gushyira
mu bikorwa amahame n'inshingano
bikubiye muri aya Masezerano.
2. Komisiyo itegura kandi igashyikiriza
Inteko, ibinyujije mu Nama Nyobozi,
Raporo ikomatanyije yerekeye ishyirwa
mu bikorwa ry’aya Masezerano, kugira
ngo isuzumwe.

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo kwemera, gutanga ibihembo no kwizihiza 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bigomba gushyiraho uburyo bukorera mu
articles.text:
mucyo kandi butabogamye bwo guha
agaciro ibikorwa by'indashyikirwa, no
guhanga udushya mu bijyanye no
kwegereza abaturage ubuyobozi,
imiyoborere n'iterambere by'inzego
z’ibanze.
2. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bishyiraho ku rwego rw’umugabane
uburyo bwo kwemera n’ibihembo kugira
ngo hahembwe kandi hashishikarizwe
ibirebana no kwegereza abaturage
ubuyobozi, imiyoborere yo ku rwego
rw’ibanze n’iterambere ryo ku rwego
rw’ibanze.
3. Komisiyo iteza imbere ibyagezweho mu
guhanga udushya kandi ishyiraho uburyo
bwo gutanga ibihembo mu guhanga
udushya mu kwegereza abaturage ibikorwa
by’ubuyobozi, imiyoborere yo ku rwego
rw’ibanze n’iterambere ryo ku rwego
rw’ibanze.
4. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bizajya byizihiza "Umunsi Nyafurika
wahariwe kwegereza abaturage ubuyobozi
n'Iterambere ryo ku rwego rw’ibanze" ku
itariki ya 10 Kanama buri mwaka, mu
rwego rwo guteza imbere indangagaciro
n'amahame by’aya Masezerano.
UMUTWE WA IV: INGINGO ZISOZA

articles.heading: Ingingo zirebana n’izigama 1. Ibiteganyijwe muri aya Masezerano ntibishobora gusobanurwa mu buryo
articles.text:
bunyuranyije n’amahame ajyanye
n’amategeko mpuzamahanga, harimo
n’umuco mpuzamahanga.
2. Nta na kimwe mu biteganyijwe muri aya
Masezerano kigira ingaruka ku ngingo
zirushijeho kuba nziza, zijyanye no
kwegereza abaturage ubuyobozi,
imiyoborere yo ku rwego rw’ibanze
n’iterambere ryo ku rwego rw’ibanze
bikubiye mu mategeko y’imbere mu
bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
cyangwa mu yandi masezerano ayo ari yo
yose yo ku rwego rw’akarere, ku rwego
rw’umugabane cyangwa ku rwego
mpuzamahanga akurikizwa muri ibi
bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano.
3. Mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’aya
Masezerano, umwihariko n'ibyifuzo
byihariye by'ibihugu byo mu birwa
bigomba kwitabwaho.

articles.heading: Gukemura impaka 1. Impaka izo ari zo zose zijyanye n'aya Masezerano zikemurwa mu bwumvikane
articles.text:
binyuze mu mishyikirano itaziguye hagati
y’ibihugu birebwa bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano.
2. Iyo impaka zidakemuwe binyuze mu
mishyikirano itaziguye, ibihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano byihatira gukemura
impaka hakoreshejwe ubundi buryo
bw’amahoro, harimo imishyikirano,
ubwunzi n’ubwiyunge, cyangwa ubundi
buryo bw’amahoro bwumvikanyweho
n’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano.
Muri urwo rwego, ibihugu bihuriye kuri
aya masezerano bishishikarizwa gukoresha
inzira n’uburyo bwo gukemura impaka
yashyizweho mu rwego rw’Umuryango.

articles.heading: Gushyira umukono ku Masezerano, kuyemeza burundu cyangwa kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho
articles.text:
Aya Masezerano yemerewe gushyirwaho
umukono, kwemezwa burundu no
kwemerera ibihugu kwemera kuba bimwe
mu biyahuriyeho, ibihugu byose bigize
Umuryango, hakurikijwe uburyo
buteganywa n’Amategeko Nshinga yabyo.

articles.heading: Gutangira gukurikizwa Aya Masezerano atangira gukurikizwa mu minsi mirongo itatu (30) nyuma y’itariki
articles.text:
Perezida wa Komisiyo y’Umuryango wa
Afurika Yunze Ubumwe yakiriyeho
inyandiko ya cumi na gatanu (15) yo
kuyemeza burundu.

articles.heading: Ivugururwa 1. Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano icyo ari cyo cyose gishobora gutanga ibyifuzo
articles.text:
byo kuvugurura cyangwa gusubiramo aya
Masezerano.
2. Ibitekerezo byo kuvugurura cyangwa
gusubiramo bishyikirizwa Perezida wa
Komisiyo y'Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze
Ubumwe, na we akabyoherereza ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano mu gihe
cy’iminsi mirongo itatu (30) uhereye igihe
byakiriwe.
3. Inteko y’Umuryango, bisabwe n’Inama
Nyobozi y’Umuryango, isuzuma ibyo
byifuzo mu nama yayo ikurikira, mu gihe
ibihugu byose byamenyeshejwe nibura
amezi atatu (3) mbere y’uko inama
itangira.
4. Inteko y’Umuryango yemeza
amavugururwa hakurikijwe amategeko
agenga imikorere yayo.
5. Amavugururwa cyangwa gusubirwamo
bitangira gukurikizwa hakurikijwe
ibivugwa mu ngingo ya 24 yavuzwe
haruguru.

articles.heading: Ushinzwe kubika Amasezerano 1. Inyandiko yo kwemeza burundu cyangwa kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
articles.text:
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bishyikirizwa Perezida wa Komisiyo
y’Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe.
2. Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kiri muri aya
Masezerano gishobora kwivana muri aya
Masezerano gitanga integuza mu nyandiko
mu gihe cy’umwaka umwe (1) kuri
Perezida wa Komisiyo y’Umuryango wa
Afurika Yunze Ubumwe.
3. Perezida wa Komisiyo y’Umuryango wa
Afurika Yunze Ubumwe amenyesha
ibihugu bigize uyu Muryango ibijyanye
n’umukono uwo ari wo wose w’aya
Masezerano, ukwakira kose kw’inyandiko
yo kwemeza burundu cyangwa yo
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano, ndetse n'ibijyanye no
gutangira gukurikizwa kwayo.
4. Perezida wa Komisiyo amenyesha kandi
ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
ibijyanye n’ubusabe bw’amavugururwa
cyangwa kwivana mu Masezerano no
kuyifataho.
5. Aya Masezerano agitangira
gukurikizwa, Perezida wa Komisiyo
ayandikisha mu gitabo
cy'Umunyamabanga Mukuru
w'Umuryango w'Abibumbye, hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa mu ngingo ya 102
y'Amasezerano mpuzamahanga ashyiraho
Umuryango w'Abibumbye.
6. Aya Masezerano yanditswe mu
nyandiko enye (4) z’umwimerere mu
ndimi z'Icyarabu, Icyongereza, Igifaransa
n'Igiporutugali, inyandiko zose uko ari
enye (4) zinganya agaciro, zishyikirizwa
Perezida wa Komisiyo na we
agashyikiriza inyandukuro ihuje
n’umwimerere y’Amasezerano buri
gihugu mu bigize Umuryango wa Afurika
Yunze Ubumwe mu rurimi rwemewe
gikoresha.
